messages:
Maya: Heads-up: midnight change window starts in ~40m. We're doing the EU slice freeze + quiet window. Posting the quick handoff checklist and rollback criteria here. @Jordan @Carla please confirm you'll take handoff. :bell:
Jordan: Oncall here — I can take the handoff at t-minus 20. I'll be on pager and in release-war-room.
Carla: Docs updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/overnight-slice-freeze. TL;DR: pin runtime to v3.2.1, disable autoscale burst during quiet window, pre-warm canary pool to avoid cold starts.
Maya: Pin decision: locking model runtime to commit "abc123" and pin deploy-bot routing for canary -> group "eu-slice-3". No schema migrations during freeze.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout to eu-slice-3 initiated at 1708234720. Canary concurrency=50 req/s, health hooks enabled.
Ben: Smoke tests queued. Quick local smoke command: ```./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env=eu --canary=eu-slice-3``` Will kick off and share results.
Jordan: Rollback thresholds proposal: auto-rollback if error rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 120% of baseline for 5m. Manual rollback also allowed for embedding cost spike > 30%/hour or data integrity alerts. Ack?
Carla: Ack. Also adding the metric hook to #release-war-room and enabling paging on the new latency alert. DeployLock set for hotfix exemptions — must include a reason and owner.
Maya: Added notes: exclude KMS key rotation window from this change, update firewall allowlist for the canary pool. Reminder: no mass DB writes or migrations in quiet window.
deploy-bot: canary health check: all probes passing. p95 latency 82ms (baseline 78ms), error 0.2%. Proceeding -> scaling to 25% traffic at 1708234820.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: quiet window boundaries are 00:00-06:00 UTC. Escalation order for this slice: Jordan -> Ben -> Maya. Pager policy live.
Ben: I'm watching dashboards; if you see KV cache errors run: ```kubectl logs -l app=redwood-runtime -n eu | grep kvcache``` and ping me. I'll be available for emergency rollback.
Jordan: Handing off to night ops at 1708234900. I'll post a stable-for-30m confirmation once we hit it.
Maya: Thanks. Rollback playbook summary (runbook link in docs): 1) revert runtime pin to v3.1.9 2) pause routing to eu-slice-3 3) scale canary down 4) notify status page and customers if >5% impacted. Keep comms short and time-stamped. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Final canary update: rollout completed to eu-slice-3 at 1708234980. Health OK. Automated fallback rule remains enabled in case of downstream regressions. :rocket:
